articles.summary: Teradata announced that it will participate in the RBC's 2024 Global TIMT Conference in New York, NY (November 19th), the Wells Fargo's 2024 TMT Summit in San Francisco, CA (December 4th) and the Barclay's 2024 Global TMT Conference in San Francisco, CA (December 11th). Presenters will include Steve McMillian, President and Chief Executive Officer as well as Claire Bramley, Chief Financial Officer.
